stem:
The shaded part of the model represents a fraction. The X in the model represents another fraction that was subtracted from the first fraction.

What subtraction expression does the model represent?
instruction: Move the correct answer to each box. Each answer may be used more than once. Not all answers will be used.
visual_elements: circle divided into three parts, two shaded and one labeled 'X' in shaded part
notes: The problem is a drag and drop requiring two fractions to fill the subtraction expression based on visual fraction model.
